subject: Azure Marketplace private plan — co-sell revenue share & entitlement exhibit
messages:
From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@microsoft.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Azure Marketplace private plan — draft entitlement exhibit and co-sell split

Hi Priyom / Kimberly,

Following up from our call: attaching the draft entitlement exhibit for the Azure Marketplace private plan for FinWave. Microsoft Legal asked that we capture the co-sell revenue share and entitlement flow before listing. Key asks from partner/marketplace side:

- Revenue share: 20% of marketplace net receipts to Microsoft for co-sell inclusion.
- Entitlements: SAML SSO required, VNet peering allowed, Private Offer flow via CSP.
- Billing path: customer (FinWave) will expect invoice from Redwood; Microsoft requires a revenue reporting feed monthly.

I've attached the initial exhibit (Azure_PrivatePlan_Entitlement_Exhibit_v2.pdf) and a checklist for private offers. Can you confirm if Redwood can accept the 20% split and the data residency language below, or will you propose redlines?

Proposed timeline:
- Confirm commercial splits + entitlements by EOW (Nov 13)
- Fill DocuSign envelope once redlines are agreed
- Marketplace preview and listing targeted Nov 23

Oliver Hayes at FinWave (cc'd in separate thread) is ready to sign once we have the private offer configuration and the commercial terms.

Thanks — happy to jump on 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Emma Collins
Partner Manager, Microsoft Azure Marketplace

+1 425 555 0133

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Collins <emma.collins@microsoft.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, legal@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace private plan — draft entitlement exhibit and co-sell split

Emma, thanks for the exhibit and checklist. We reviewed with commercial/legal — see primary redlines and open items below. I'm attaching our annotated PDF (Redlines_Azure_Exhibit_Priyom_v1.pdf).

Primary redlines / asks:
1) Revenue share: Microsoft requests 20%. Redwood can approve up to 17.5% for co-sell if Microsoft will accept a 50/50 advertising cost share (we run GTM). If MS insists on 20% flat, we'll need an incrementally higher list price to the customer or a marketing credit.
2) Data residency & logs: we need explicit confirmation that PII from telemetry will not be routed to MS for analytics. Add clause: telemetry export requires customer consent and is restricted to anonymized usage metrics.
3) Indemnity / liability cap: propose limiting Redwood's liability to fees paid in the prior 12 months vs. uncapped.
4) Private offer flow: confirm that the offer can be created as a private plan with access granted by customer subscription ID (FinWave) and that billing will be routed to Redwood (not MS).
5) SLA: marketplace SLA fine, but we require the ability to pass-through SLA credits to customer rather than Microsoft withholding settlement.

Requested next steps:
- Kimberly/Steph, can you review the revenue-share compromise (17.5% + 50/50 co-marketing) and sign off?
- Emma: if Microsoft wants to propose alternate language, please send a marked exhibit and DocuSign when ready.

We're generally supportive of the private plan listing; the above are gating for Legal/Finance. Oliver (FinWave) is ready to move fast once commercial terms are fixed.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0199

--
Attachment: Redlines_Azure_Exhibit_Priyom_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Internal - Azure private plan negotiation (FinWave)

Quick internal — copying the redlines above. Recommendation: accept 17.5% with a 12-month marketing credit equal to 2.5% of list for the first 6 months. Rationale: keeps overall economics near-nyquist for the deal and buys a co-sell motion that can unlock an enterprise account.

Questions for Steph / Kim:
- Can Finance accept a monthly revenue reporting feed (to avoid invoice reconciliation issues)?
- Legal: are we okay with the proposed telemetry language (anonymized usage only) or do we need stronger carve-outs?

If we get a firm concession on revenue share, I'll approve countersign via DocuSign. If Microsoft refuses to move, we should push a brief PO-based procurement route (FinWave preferring Redwood invoice) rather than list as-is.

Priyom

Hi all,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We ran your redlines by MS Legal and Product. Microsoft can accept a commercial compromise: 18.5% revenue share to Microsoft with the following concessions:

- Microsoft agrees to anonymized usage telemetry only; any raw telemetry transfer requires explicit customer authorization.
- Marketplace will support billing routed to Redwood; Microsoft will request monthly revenue reporting feed for reconciliation.
- Microsoft updated indemnity language to cap mutual liability at fees paid in prior 12 months (see attached Exhibit v3).

I've uploaded the updated exhibit and created a DocuSign envelope for signatures. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/DocuSign/Envelope/7890

We need confirmation of the billing contact and PO terms (FinWave expects Net 30). Also include any special tax or marketplace reseller requirements.

Attachment: Azure_PrivatePlan_Entitlement_Exhibit_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

Let me know if you want to take to VP-level, otherwise we can sign and proceed to marketplace preview.

Best,
Emma Collins
Partner Manager, Microsoft Azure Marketplace
